sources.title: The 2026 AI Landscape: A Hacker's Deep Dive • oreoro
sources.snippet: The single biggest shift in 2026 is from generative AI (creates content) to agentic AI (autonomous systems that plan, decide, and execute). Where a generative model answers your question, an agentic AI accomplishes your goal.
